comments.author: Wystein
comments.body:
To expand a bit on Battousai's comment. Some regions like the Baltic Sea have different ambush fleets based on your total levels. And in this case while the different ambush fleets have the same name (Swedish Privateers) only one version has the Thor's thunder item as a rare plunder item.

This version it appears only ambush's "high level" characters. I do not know what is considered high level for this purpose though. I was around 200 total levels when I plundered it for what that is worth.

The way to tell if your dealing with the correct fleet is what items you are plundering. The fleet that drops the Thor's thunder also drops Seals of Vakyrie.

And for anybody getting into rare item plundering I highely recommend searching up Akasan's UWO blog, an excellent resource.
